key_insight: AI can unify fragmented studies of 3D CsPbX3 instability by linking failure diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability prediction, and stability engineering into one workflow.
engineering_relevance: This framework can help accelerate the design of more durable inorganic perovskite devices for photovoltaics, photodetectors, and light-emitting applications.
evidence_signal: The review emphasizes that current work is limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based analysis.
watch_item: Practical deployment still depends on better data quality, consistent test protocols, interpretable models, and transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
